summary.text: Larry Nostrant is the Democratic candidate for the Idaho House of Representatives, District 7A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Kyle Harris (R).
Nostrant is a U.S. Coast Guard veteran who retired as a construction manager in 2012.

paragraphs.text: Larry Nostrant earned a bachelor's degree from Central Washington University in 1984, and Ballotpedia lists his military service as the U.S. Coast Guard from 1971 to 1987.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a "Conservative Democrat," a Coast Guard veteran educated in public and governmental finance, and said he retired as a construction manager in 2012 and has since volunteered with Idaho Parks and Recreation.

In the same survey, Nostrant said he would seek to adjust the homeowners property tax exemption, remove the sales tax on groceries, restore full funding to public K-12 education, and preserve government ownership of public lands.
